question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

His __industrious__ attitude was the reason for his promotion.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"industrious"** means hardworking and diligent. (मेहनती)

 
 
• **Example: **Her** industrious** nature earned her the title of Employee of the Month.
 
 
 
• **"Lazy"** refers to someone who is unwilling to work or use energy. (आलसी)
 
 
• **Example: **He is too** lazy** to clean his room.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'industrious'** is **'lazy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hazy **(धुंधला): Lacking clarity.

 
 
• **Example:** The details of the contract were** hazy **and unclear.
 
 
 
• **Efficient **(कुशल): Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.
 
 
• **Example: **The new machine is much more **efficient** than the old one.
 
 
 
• **Pricey** (महंगा): Expensive.
 
 
• **Example:** The restaurant was too **pricey **for our budget.
